notes.title: Planned Update
notes.content: We are planning some needed changes to Very Real Chess due to the recent feedback we have received. One of these being a much needed undo button. Please work with us during the following weeks to bring this game to its fullest potential. Thanks for all the feedback and as always feel free to contact us with your questions or ideas to improve the game.

notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.content:
We are very excited about the release of Very Real Chess!

The team worked very hard to bring this game to the Steam community and we hope that you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it. Feel free to contact us about any problems that you may find. We are still looking for fun and exciting ways to improve this game.
